display.title: After Shavuos: Hashem Gives Us the Torah Every Day
display.summary_short: Looking back on Shavuos, Uncle Yossi explains why we bless Hashem 'Who gives the Torah' every morning, and how to make summer vacation a time for more Torah and mitzvos.
display.summary_long: The opening talk of a Tzivos Hashem radio show broadcast just after Shavuos. Uncle Yossi recalls hearing the Ten Commandments together in shul, united like one person with one heart, saying Tehillim in honor of Dovid HaMelech's yahrzeit on Shavuos, and staying up for the Tikkun Leil Shavuos, which holds parts of the whole Torah. Every morning we remember Shavuos in the blessing over the Torah: we say 'Nosein HaTorah', Who gives the Torah, in the present, because Hashem gives it to us anew each day with fresh strength to learn and do mitzvos. Shavuos comes just before summer vacation, a time with more free hours, so soldiers in Hashem's army should set aside daily time for davening and learning, reviewing last year's lessons or preparing for next year. He wishes everyone a healthy, safe and happy summer and advises choosing a camp where children daven, learn and keep the mitzvos.
display.lesson: Hashem gives us the Torah anew every day; use the free time of summer to learn more and do more mitzvos.

quality.notes: Starts with the show's opening greeting. The transcript has a gap at about 4:45-5:24 (speech not transcribed); the clip ends mid-thought about choosing a Jewish camp.
